data.notes: Search budget (20) used; one search returned too_many_requests. Caddy data is ADAC-only fallback (no manufacturer press data found). Caddy Maxi 7-seat trunk value (ADAC 'normal'): 530 l for both Maxi Life (2K) and Caddy 4 Maxi. Golf generations use calendar production years (V 10/2003-2008, VI 10/2008-2012, VII 11/2012-2017, VII facelift 2017-2020), matching existing DB style.

corrections.evidence: auto motor und sport Golf GTE test data: Kofferraumvolumen 272 bis 1162 l.
auto motor und sport Golf GTE test data: 272-1162 l (carwow quotes 1126 l folded; ams value preferred).
2014 Golf R 4MOTION: Boot/Load Space Min 343 L, Max 1233 L; same 343/1233 on auto.ru (2013-2017 Golf R VII) and caroom.fr (300 PS).
2014 Golf R 4MOTION: Boot/Load Space Max 1233 L.
e-Golf (2014-2019): 341 l seats up, 1231 l folded; carbuyer: battery under raised floor reduces 380 -> 341 l. Same as facelift values.
e-Golf 2014-2019: 1231 l with rear seats folded.
AUTO BILD Golf VII GTD Fahrbericht: 380 Liter Kofferraum; autoplenum (schraegheck-2012 GTD 184 PS) also 380 l; ams GTD facelift test 380-1270 l.
ams GTD (Facelift) test: Kofferraumvolumen 380 bis 1270 l; autozine.nl golf-vii 2.0 GTD also 380/1270. Body unchanged vs. pre-facelift hatch.
AUTO BILD Golf R32 (Golf V, 250 PS): Kofferraum 275-1230 l; autoscout24.at R32 4MOTION and autoplenum (schraegheck-2003 R32 250 PS) also 275 l.
autoscout24.at Golf 2.0 GTI 147 kW (200 PS), 4204 mm long, 2578 mm wheelbase (Golf V GTI): Kofferraum 350 l. Folded value not confirmed (low-tier source).
ams Golf 6 GTI test data: 4213 x 1786 x 1469 mm, Kofferraumvolumen 350 bis 1305 l.

AUTO BILD GTE facelift test: hybrid battery costs 108 l of trunk vs. 380 l Golf -> 272 l; same 272 l as pre-facelift GTE (ams). Folded value presumably 1162 l as pre-facelift but not directly confirmed for facelift. Medium confidence.
ADAC Caddy Life 1.4 (07/04-06/06): Länge 4405 mm, Höhe 1833 mm (that page lists Breite 1802 mm; other ADAC Caddy III pages 1794 mm). Matches the autokosten.net 1833 already noted.

verification.notes: 19 of 20 searches used. Confirmed: Golf VI 4199/1779/1461-1480/2578 (newsroom), Golf VI 350/1305, Golf VII 380/1270 (ams GTD), Golf VII TGI length 4255, Golf V GTI/hatch trunk 350, Caddy III facelift 4406/1853/750/2850 (ADAC 224774), Caddy Life 4405 and 750/2850 (ADAC 1.4 06/06-08/10), Caddy Maxi Life height 1834, Caddy 4 750 l and length 4408 (autoplenum), Caddy Maxi 530 l. Not confirmed/uncertain: Caddy 4 height 1792 (autoplenum 1.0 TSI lists 1858 mm, a Russian spec page 1822 mm; no clear source for one value, so not corrected); Caddy 4 folded 3030 l (carwow range 2556-3105); Golf VI R trunk sources conflict (350/1305 autoscout vs 275/1230 autoplenum) so left null; Golf V and VII dimensions not independently re-verified beyond the above.
